records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total revenue decreased by $27.3 million, or 30.8%, to $61.7 million from $89.0 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We have existing relationships with all major OEMs or their tier 1 suppliers, and while our customer contracts vary, they generally represent multi-year engagements, giving us some level of visibility into future revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As of June 30, 2023, our net working capital, excluding deferred revenue and deferred costs, was $118.4 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating margin decreased 31.5 percentage points to negative 13.8% from 17.7%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash used in operating activities was $8.2 million, a net change of $4.3 million from cash used in operating activities of $3.9 million.
